summary: Repaired and committed the portal token ownership candidate at source revision 65c5b87badfd6bde87ada56583b25be0b3633ce6. The approved Fitness V2 presentation is now an explicit static route; arbitrary classic tokens, including tokens ending in -v2, retain exact-token classic ownership.
evidence: Focused Vitest command passed: 2 files and 21 tests.
TypeScript and changed-file ESLint commands passed.
The collision controls prove client and client-v2 render only their own classic signed report, while the explicit Fitness V2 route renders the Fitness base report with sidebar presentation.
The bounded frontend build lists both /google-ads/portal/[token] and /google-ads/portal/local-fitness-review-v2 as dynamic routes.
